explanation: I used WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment() to parse the fragment with structural awareness, then scanned only opening tags via next_tag() and inspected each matched UL/OL element’s get_breadcrumbs() to detect whether any UL or OL appears in its ancestor path. Matching nested lists get add_class('nested-list'), and the modified fragment is returned with get_updated_html() so untouched bytes are preserved exactly.
